Baxi expands Megaflo range to give installers more options 

Date: 8 September, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:15
Instaread

Baxi has expanded its Megaflo cylinder portfolio with the launch of the new Megaflo Essential range of direct, and indirect cylinders and the brand’s first air source heat pump (ASHP) cylinder.  

The company says the range has been developed in response to installer requests for solutions that address common challenges, including budget constraints, and growing consumer demand for heat pump-compatible options. 

Designed for use with residential heat pumps, including Baxi’s HP40 and HP60 ASHPs, the Megaflo Essential ASHP cylinder has been designed to optimise hot water performance in heat pump applications. Features include a high surface area coil, twin 3kW immersion heaters and a secondary return connection. 

Rob Pearse, Residential Business Director at Baxi said: “Megaflo has a great reputation among heating engineers. We’ve heard installers say ‘Megaflo’ when they mean ‘cylinder’ – that’s a privilege and a responsibility that we take seriously. 

“We set out to provide installers with a Megaflo that can cater to all budgets and installation requirements while maintaining and refining the renowned Megaflo quality and reliability. Whether engineers need a slimline cylinder for a smaller property, a solution for an air source heat pump or compatibility with solar PV, there’s a Megaflo cylinder designed for exactly that application.”
